title: Composed supervisory control: Pause/resume sequence with abort recovery -> Branching item sorter sequence

inputs.name: B_ItemPresent
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Item at inspection point

inputs.name: B_RejectClass
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Item classified for rejection

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 idle, 1 step1, 2 step2, 3 done

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 wait, 1 inspect, 2 accept, 3 reject

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan A_Start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start shall begin Step 1 only when idle and not A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G((A_State=0 AND A_Start AND !A_Aborted AND !A_Abort) -> X(A_State=1))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Advance shall move Step 1 to Step 2 and Step 2 to done only while not A_Paused.
requirements.property: G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=1)->X(A_State=2)) AND G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=2)->X(A_State=3))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Pause shall suppress active step outputs without losing A_State; A_Resume clears A_Paused.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Abort shall return A_State to idle, suppress outputs, clear A_Paused, and latch A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G(A_Abort -> (A_State=0 AND !A_Step1 AND !A_Step2 AND !A_Paused AND A_Aborted))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Aborted only while A_Start, A_Advance, A_Pause, A_Resume, and A_Abort are all FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_ItemPresent in wait B_State shall enter inspection.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=0 AND B_ItemPresent AND !B_Reset) -> X(B_State=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Inspection shall branch to reject when B_RejectClass is TRUE and to accept otherwise.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=1 AND B_RejectClass) -> X(B_State=3))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=1 AND !B_RejectClass) -> X(B_State=2)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_TransferDone in either transfer B_State shall return to wait.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (((B_State=2 OR B_State=3) AND B_TransferDone) -> X(B_State=0)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Inspect, B_AcceptGate, and B_RejectGate shall be mutually exclusive and match B_State.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall return to wait and close both gates.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Reset -> (B_State=0 AND !B_Inspect AND !B_AcceptGate AND !B_RejectGate)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Step1 shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Inspect AND NOT B_AcceptGate AND NOT B_RejectGate AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Inspect AND NOT B_AcceptGate AND NOT B_RejectGate AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
